questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A man of mass 60 kg stands on a weighing machine inside a lift that is accelerating upwards at 2 m s⁻². The reading of the machine (g = 10 m s⁻²) corresponds to a force of:
questions.explanation: For upward acceleration N = m(g + a) = 60(10 + 2) = 720 N, so the apparent weight is greater than the true weight.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 4: Laws of Motion

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A Carnot engine works between a source at 500 K and a sink at 300 K. Its efficiency is:
questions.explanation: η = 1 - T₂/T₁ = 1 - 300/500 = 0.4, that is 40 percent. No real engine between these temperatures can do better.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Substances that are feebly repelled by a magnetic field and move from a stronger to a weaker part of the field are called:
questions.explanation: Diamagnetic substances such as bismuth, copper and water have no net magnetic moment and are weakly repelled; paramagnetics are weakly attracted.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 5: Magnetism and Matter

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: The first ionisation enthalpy of nitrogen is higher than that of oxygen because nitrogen has:
questions.explanation: Half-filled 2p³ in nitrogen is extra stable, so more energy is needed to remove an electron than from oxygen, where electron-electron repulsion in a paired 2p orbital helps removal.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following 0.1 molal aqueous solutions will have the highest boiling point?
questions.explanation: Elevation of boiling point depends on the number of particles. The van't Hoff factor is 1 for glucose and urea, 2 for NaCl and 3 for CaCl₂.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The pentose sugar present in ribonucleic acid (RNA) is:
questions.explanation: RNA contains β-D-ribose with an OH group at C-2, whereas DNA contains 2-deoxyribose, which lacks that oxygen and is therefore more stable.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The stage of mitosis in which all the chromosomes line up at the equatorial plate is:
questions.explanation: At metaphase the chromosomes are most condensed and their centromeres align on the metaphase plate, making this the best stage for studying chromosome shape.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 10: Cell Cycle and Cell Division

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In the lac operon of E. coli, the role of lactose is to act as:
questions.explanation: Lactose binds the repressor protein so it can no longer sit on the operator, and transcription of z, y and a genes begins. This is negative regulation.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 5: Molecular Basis of Inheritance

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The total number of bones in the skeleton of a normal human adult is:
questions.explanation: The adult human skeleton has 206 bones, made of 80 axial and 126 appendicular bones. A newborn has many more, which later fuse.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 17: Locomotion and Movement

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Copper releasing intrauterine devices such as CuT prevent pregnancy mainly by:
options: Suppressing sperm motility and their fertilising capacity
questions.explanation: Copper ions released into the uterus suppress sperm motility and fertilising capacity, and the device also increases phagocytosis of sperms.
